payload.chapter_text: That sound of distant thunder was low and ominous. Like some kind of a warning...

payload.text:
Mission Briefing: Operation Silent Thunder

Objective: Investigate and facilitate takeover of remote research facility.
Location: Isolated island, coordinates [REDACTED]
Warning: Communication blackout reported. Proceed with extreme caution.
Extraction: 12 hours post-deployment. Return to drop coordinates.
Risk Assessment: HIGH

Note: Local reports mention unexplained disappearances. Maintain vigilance.
A flash of lightning illuminates the horizon. The storm is getting closer...

set_storm_warning_flag.description: Set storm warning flag to true

payload.text:
The deck hands lower an inflatable boat into the choppy water. One of them hands you a waterproof pack.

"This is it," says the captain. "Twelve hours. Not a minute longer."

You climb down the ladder into the inflatable. The motor sputters to life.

As the boat pulls away from the freighter, you see two possible destinations through the mist:

1. A weathered dock closer to the main island
2. A lighthouse perched on a small outcropping

Where do you want to go?

create_destination_exits.description: Add exits to dock and lighthouse

payload.text: The storm finally hits with full force. Rain lashes down, and visibility drops to almost nothing. Thunder crashes overhead. You need to find shelter soon.

equipment_check.description: Check if player has required equipment

payload.text: You check your equipment before disembarking. Everything seems to be in order.
You should check the supply case on deck before disembarking - you might be missing essential equipment.
